prompt: In which year did California experience its second instance of wildfires burning more than 2 million acres, destroying scores of homes and other buildings?
answer: California’s second year with more than 2 million acres burned by wildfires was **2021**. Approximately **2.23 million acres** burned, destroying thousands of structures.
